what: What happened when each script in public/community-blockers.json was installed and run here, one at a time with the engine up: the campaigns written down in docs/11-MISSING.md, sections 9, 17, 18 and 19. The blockers table says what is MISSING and is worked out from the source; this says what that cost, and is measured. A verdict counts only while the script is still in that table — one that is fixed leaves the table and its row here stops meaning anything. A script in the table and not here gets the plain 'something is missing' mark. A row with `samples` is a script that needs a pack of samples a person downloads by hand: its standing goes once the folder named in `holds` has files in it, and the store offers the download and the import on its page.

verdicts.no: it starts, or tries to, and cannot do what it is for
verdicts.part: it runs and plays, with a part of it absent
verdicts.needs: it runs once something is done, and the label says what

amenbreak.measured: it asks for a restart for ever: its 293 MB of audio and two programs come from a GitHub release, which a page may not fetch

arp_index.measured: it starts, 153 pixels lit, silent: cloud.iexapis.com, where its numbers come from, has closed — on a norns too

cheat_codes_2.label: needs a midi device
cheat_codes_2.measured: it stops in ping_midi_devices with no MIDI device attached, and runs with one: the keyboard in the rail is enough

fixed-filter-banking-crisis.label: brings fx with it
fixed-filter-banking-crisis.measured: it runs, 301 pixels lit, with sixolet/fx beside it — which installing it here fetches too

lorenzos-drums.measured: it draws its screen and has no drums: its 66 MB of samples come from a GitHub release, which a page may not fetch

makebreakbeat.measured: it starts, 147 pixels lit; sox, the program that does its work, is built for the Raspberry Pi and is not here

moonraker.label: needs its samples
moonraker.measured: it starts and stays silent, and every turn of E1 is 'interval is empty' at line 445: its eight banks are folders of a sample pack that is not here — on a norns without the pack too

norns.online.measured: it draws its screen; the program that does its sharing is built for the Raspberry Pi and is not here

paracosms.measured: what the catalogue points at is only an installer, for plugins built for the Raspberry Pi

pirate-radio.measured: it runs and plays, peak 0.137; dust2dust and ogg123, which it broadcasts and plays files with, are programs for the Raspberry Pi

sampswap.measured: it draws its screen and stays silent, peak 0.0005: sox and sendosc, which do its work, are programs built for the Raspberry Pi

tulpamancer.measured: it stops at line 46: the file it asks nyse.com for is one no page is allowed to read

vials.measured: its repository answers 404, on GitHub and on jsDelivr, on main and on master

zxcvbn.measured: it starts, 120 pixels lit, silent: its tools come from a GitHub release and are built for the Raspberry Pi
